solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/defanging-an-ip-address/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1108. Defanging an IP Address

Given a valid (IPv4) IP address, return a defanged version of that IP address.

A defanged IP address replaces every period "." with "[.]".

Example 1:

Input: address = "1.1.1.1"
Output: "1[.]1[.]1[.]1"

Example 2:

Input: address = "255.100.50.0"
Output: "255[.]100[.]50[.]0"

Constraints:

    The given address is a valid IPv4 address.
"""


class Solution:
    def defangIPaddr(self, address: str) -> str:
        return address.replace(".", "[.]")


sol = Solution()

print(sol.defangIPaddr("1.1.1.1"))  # "1[.]1[.]1[.]1"

assert sol.defangIPaddr("1.1.1.1") == "1[.]1[.]1[.]1"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("255.100.50.0") == "255[.]100[.]50[.]0"

assert sol.defangIPaddr("0.0.0.0") == "0[.]0[.]0[.]0"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("255.255.255.255") == "255[.]255[.]255[.]255"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("192.168.0.1") == "192[.]168[.]0[.]1"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("10.0.0.1") == "10[.]0[.]0[.]1"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("172.16.254.1") == "172[.]16[.]254[.]1"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("127.0.0.1") == "127[.]0[.]0[.]1"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("8.8.8.8") == "8[.]8[.]8[.]8"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("1.2.3.4") == "1[.]2[.]3[.]4"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("123.45.67.89") == "123[.]45[.]67[.]89"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("0.255.0.255") == "0[.]255[.]0[.]255"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("100.100.100.100") == "100[.]100[.]100[.]100"
assert sol.defangIPaddr("200.200.200.200") == "200[.]200[.]200[.]200"
